|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once during opponent's move phase, you may use 3 Force to look at opponent's hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. Opponent may not place cards in your Used Pile while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. During opponent’s move phase, may use 3 Force to peek at opponent’s hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner’s Used Pile. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not place those cards in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Once during opponent's” → “During opponent’s”; removed “you”; “look” → “peek”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “owner's” → “owner’s”; “Opponent” → “Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent”; added “those”; removed “your”; “Pile while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand. [Immune” → “Pile. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 36. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
